content.value: Papers as Instruments: living data, computation, and forms

This lane owns the moment a paper stops being prose and becomes an instrument — a live dashboard for an analyst, a self-grading worksheet for a teacher, a screening form for a clinic, a value-carrying model for a financial user or engineer. The investigation's headline held and sharpened under the storm: the instrument spine is roughly 80% built and almost 0% delivered — and delivered no longer means CSS (that wave shipped). It means insertability, starters, a door handle on a live endpoint, and about six deliberate capability screws. This Paper designs all of it on real machinery, with file:line anchors, and names the judgment calls that stay with the user.

The corpus study's fix order was CSS, then templates, then cookbook. The CSS wave is
done and live

(PR #5651, verified by the crown lane) — so the residual bottleneck moved. content.value: Move 1 — The analyst-notebook floor
Verdict, held after the storm's notebook-anatomy probe:
a notebook is a paper template, not a new block family.

Jupyter pulls through a kernel, Observable reacts at read time, Evidence builds statically — Barkpark already has a fourth model, event-push-on-save: saving a sheet fans fresh value snapshots into every consuming paper (content/sheets.ex:52-81), no kernel, no build step. That satisfies every READ-side essential a stakeholder needs. Three builds finish the floor:

items.value: Sheet-source chart/stat.

A chart or stat block that reads a sheet range — sheetRef + range attrs — hydrated by the same write-through that refreshes sheet embeds. No new fetcher, no new privacy surface: the values already live in the paper, and the draft/publish write-gate (PR #840) already guards leakage.
The chart-statistics pack.

The professional floor, ranked below — shipped as kind/attrs extensions of the existing chart block, never as new block types (keeps the 60-type parity pin still, and inherits the wishlist's own rankings instead of re-voting them).
The freshness stamp.

As-of-T-from-S chrome on every resolved block, all three surfaces. Email already snapshots at send — it just never says so. This is the one READ-side property Barkpark's model lacks versus all three notebook tools, and it is also the lane's sharpest doctrine question (see Risks).

content.value: Move 3 — Computed cells stay in sheets

The storm's sheets census settles this: the formula engine is a pure ~90-function Excel-class library (XLOOKUP, SUMPRODUCT, a full statistics suite, UNIQUE/SORT/FILTER/SEQUENCE, Kahn-algorithm cycle detection, deterministic volatile-as-of-save), with hard caps (50k cells import, 200k snapshot positions) and a draft/publish write-gate on embeds that was proven merged (sp-embed-leak-decision → PR #840 — the task id resolves; this lane's framing said otherwise and was wrong). Proposed doctrine:
sheets are the one formula context; papers reference them.

Financial models and engineering calc sheets live in sheets; papers carry value snapshots (sheet embed, and Move 1's sheet-source chart/stat). The rival — an inline formula or total-row inside the paper's table block — is rejected for v1: a second formula context means a second dependency graph, a second cycle detector, and a second parity surface across three renderers. A narrow table total-row could be a later exception; ratification is left to the user. The engineers' units story already has its seed: field-number renders a unit suffix today (pdrender/fields.go:238).

Recommended build order — and the build-vs-light split it encodes. Wave 1 (light + trust): Move 0 starters/templates/cookbook links, stage-1 submit UI, the freshness stamp. Wave 2 (capability): chart-statistics pack with three-surface sets, question types v2, quiz mode. Wave 3 (generalization): form_responses as the first non-task agg source, sheet-source chart/stat. Document-source aggregates stay deferred entirely. Rationale: corpus usage of the existing machinery is ~0 and the insert census proves users could never reach it — lighting first is also the cheapest falsifiable demand test.

The canonical numbers are 75 / 60 / 66.

TUI is not the weak parity leg — and email is stronger than believed.

All 75 types have dedicated Go renderers, zero fallback. Email has 20 hand-coded twins (including every data-viz block) plus ~50 types on the byte-frozen palette-swap path. The real asymmetry is FEATURE parity: chart annotations shipped web-only despite the type-level gate.
The wishlist already ranked this lane's blocks — inherit, don't re-vote.

All 12 S-tier blocks are DONE as of 2026-07-23 (fresher than memory). Histogram B-tier 3.15, scatter B 3.15, box-plot C 2.55 — consistent with kind-extensions, not new blocks. Matrix/likert has NO entry anywhere in the 100: the question-grid is genuinely new design space.
A Barkpark notebook is a template; the refresh model is novel.

Jupyter pulls via kernel, Observable reacts at read, Evidence builds statically. Barkpark's event-push-on-save write-through is a fourth model that already satisfies every READ-side essential. The one missing READ property across all comparisons: a visible as-of-T-from-S trust signal.
Notify-per-submission is zero-build transport.

form_response creation fires tap_broadcast, webhook dispatch (only type listener is excluded) and SSE. A webhook filtered to types form_response fires exactly once per submission today. The regulatory boundary is per-field, not per-vertical.

Named clinic intake crosses into PHI / GDPR-Art-9 territory at the first identifier (BAA/DPA required — do not claim it). Anonymous screening, feedback, and education handouts are shippable now. FERPA blocks a NAMED gradebook on a personal account, but fully anonymous submissions fall outside it — so the teacher quiz defaults to anonymous, which the endpoint already is.
Teacher demand maps 1:1 onto the portability doctrine.

The strongest TpT signal — no-prep, digital AND print from the same purchase — is literally one block list, three surfaces. The quiz feature floor was verified against Google's own docs. Honesty note: verbatim Reddit teacher quotes were unobtainable (search tooling returns zero reddit.com URLs), and several web facts carry DEMOTED-NO-RERUN provenance — beliefs, not measurements.

content.value: Risks & open questions

items.value: Byte-stability vs truth chrome.

Freshness stamps change golden-locked render bytes on all three surfaces. The same underlying question surfaces in the notation and evidence lanes (must every surface render from source, or may the server pre-resolve, as TaskResolver already does?). Flagged to the capstone (/papers/papers-pro-toolkit-capstone) as the one doctrine call no lane can settle alone.
Feature-parity slippage is proven, not hypothetical.

Annotations shipped web-only despite the 60-type parity gate — the gate locks types, not features. Every Move-1 chart feature must land as a three-surface SET with per-surface goldens, or the pack forks the surfaces further.
Each new aggregate source re-opens privacy design.

k-anon floor, measure whitelist, and visibility cross-checks were task-shaped by construction. form_responses is the easiest first source (paper-anchored, per-form scope) but still needs its own k-anon story: a 3-student quiz must not leak an individual through an aggregate.
Demand is inferred, not measured.

Corpus usage of about zero is now explained as a supply artifact — but that cuts both ways: there is no proof of pent-up demand either. Move 0 is the cheapest falsifiable test: if starters + templates move usage, build the screws; if not, re-examine before waves 2-3.
Golden-locked forms.ex.
Submit UI and question types v2 both require regenerating form.golden.json and the email twin — mechanical, but merge-order sensitive (the guard+fix co-merge trap applies).
Demoted web facts.
Google Forms close/cap, Tally/Typeform tier deltas, TpT scale figures all carry DEMOTED-NO-RERUN provenance — verify before scoping stage 6 against them.
The working tree lies.
The local checkout is behind origin/main; every form-lane fact here was read via git show origin/main. Builders must re-read from origin, never trust local absence.

Financial models and engineering calc sheets live in sheets; papers carry value snapshots (sheet embed, and Move 1's sheet-source chart/stat). The rival — an inline formula or total-row inside the paper's table block — is rejected for v1: a second formula context means a second dependency graph, a second cycle detector, and a second parity surface across three renderers. A narrow table total-row could be a later exception; ratification is left to the user. The engineers' units story already has its seed: field-number renders a unit suffix today (pdrender/fields.go:238).

Decision: three waves
Recommended build order — and the build-vs-light split it encodes. Wave 1 (light + trust): Move 0 starters/templates/cookbook links, stage-1 submit UI, the freshness stamp. Wave 2 (capability): chart-statistics pack with three-surface sets, question types v2, quiz mode. Wave 3 (generalization): form_responses as the first non-task agg source, sheet-source chart/stat. Document-source aggregates stay deferred entirely. Rationale: corpus usage of the existing machinery is ~0 and the insert census proves users could never reach it — lighting first is also the cheapest falsifiable demand test.

What we learned

  • Two of this lane's own framing facts fell. sp-embed-leak-decision DOES resolve (done; write-gate chosen; PR #840 merged 402e27fc — draft sheet saves only rewrite draft embedders). And chart DOES have a dedicated email emitter (data_viz.ex:1214) — re-verified against origin/main during this crunch; it is an honest per-series text summary (min → max · now, plus open-the-paper), i.e. the D4 degrade done properly, not a missing twin.
  • The delivery debt is no longer CSS. The reader-CSS wave shipped (PR #5651, crown-lane verified). Any plan that budgets for CSS re-litigates a solved problem; the bottleneck moved to insertability and awareness.
  • Nothing instrument-shaped is insertable. Union of every human insert mechanism = exactly 33 of 75 types. chart/stat/heatmap/sheet are excluded by design (D4 comment in slash-insert.js), form/questionnaire/equation have no path at all. This converts usage-is-zero from a demand signal into a supply artifact — the single most decision-relevant fact the storm produced for this lane.
  • The canonical numbers are 75 / 60 / 66. 29 element + 43 widget + 3 section = 75 classified in tiers.ex; 60 parity-locked (75 minus 15 schema-field/embed exclusions); 66 = 60 + 6 list aliases in the JS registry. All four count pins reconcile; earlier 70-vs-75 drift was scope confusion between census, parity scope, and registry.
  • TUI is not the weak parity leg — and email is stronger than believed. All 75 types have dedicated Go renderers, zero fallback. Email has 20 hand-coded twins (including every data-viz block) plus ~50 types on the byte-frozen palette-swap path. The real asymmetry is FEATURE parity: chart annotations shipped web-only despite the type-level gate.
  • The wishlist already ranked this lane's blocks — inherit, don't re-vote. All 12 S-tier blocks are DONE as of 2026-07-23 (fresher than memory). Histogram B-tier 3.15, scatter B 3.15, box-plot C 2.55 — consistent with kind-extensions, not new blocks. Matrix/likert has NO entry anywhere in the 100: the question-grid is genuinely new design space.
  • A Barkpark notebook is a template; the refresh model is novel. Jupyter pulls via kernel, Observable reacts at read, Evidence builds statically. Barkpark's event-push-on-save write-through is a fourth model that already satisfies every READ-side essential. The one missing READ property across all comparisons: a visible as-of-T-from-S trust signal.
  • Notify-per-submission is zero-build transport. form_response creation fires tap_broadcast, webhook dispatch (only type listener is excluded) and SSE. A webhook filtered to types form_response fires exactly once per submission today. The genuine gap is the last mile: a teacher without a webhook receiver gets nothing — email-on-submit convenience is the real build.
  • The regulatory boundary is per-field, not per-vertical. Named clinic intake crosses into PHI / GDPR-Art-9 territory at the first identifier (BAA/DPA required — do not claim it). Anonymous screening, feedback, and education handouts are shippable now. FERPA blocks a NAMED gradebook on a personal account, but fully anonymous submissions fall outside it — so the teacher quiz defaults to anonymous, which the endpoint already is.
  • Teacher demand maps 1:1 onto the portability doctrine. The strongest TpT signal — no-prep, digital AND print from the same purchase — is literally one block list, three surfaces. The quiz feature floor was verified against Google's own docs. Honesty note: verbatim Reddit teacher quotes were unobtainable (search tooling returns zero reddit.com URLs), and several web facts carry DEMOTED-NO-RERUN provenance — beliefs, not measurements.

The analyst notebook exists end-to-end today and has been used twice. The missing screw is not machinery — it is a door handle, a starter, and a timestamp.

  • Nothing instrument-shaped is insertable. Union of every human insert mechanism = exactly 33 of 75 types. chart/stat/heatmap/sheet are excluded by design (D4 comment in slash-insert.js), form/questionnaire/equation have no path at all. This converts usage-is-zero from a demand signal into a supply artifact — the single most decision-relevant fact the storm produced for this lane.
  • The canonical numbers are 75 / 60 / 66. 29 element + 43 widget + 3 section = 75 classified in tiers.ex; 60 parity-locked (75 minus 15 schema-field/embed exclusions); 66 = 60 + 6 list aliases in the JS registry. All four count pins reconcile; earlier 70-vs-75 drift was scope confusion between census, parity scope, and registry.
  • TUI is not the weak parity leg — and email is stronger than believed. All 75 types have dedicated Go renderers, zero fallback. Email has 20 hand-coded twins (including every data-viz block) plus ~50 types on the byte-frozen palette-swap path. The real asymmetry is FEATURE parity: chart annotations shipped web-only despite the type-level gate.
  • The wishlist already ranked this lane's blocks — inherit, don't re-vote. All 12 S-tier blocks are DONE as of 2026-07-23 (fresher than memory). Histogram B-tier 3.15, scatter B 3.15, box-plot C 2.55 — consistent with kind-extensions, not new blocks. Matrix/likert has NO entry anywhere in the 100: the question-grid is genuinely new design space.
  • A Barkpark notebook is a template; the refresh model is novel. Jupyter pulls via kernel, Observable reacts at read, Evidence builds statically. Barkpark's event-push-on-save write-through is a fourth model that already satisfies every READ-side essential. The one missing READ property across all comparisons: a visible as-of-T-from-S trust signal.
  • Notify-per-submission is zero-build transport. form_response creation fires tap_broadcast, webhook dispatch (only type listener is excluded) and SSE. A webhook filtered to types form_response fires exactly once per submission today. The genuine gap is the last mile: a teacher without a webhook receiver gets nothing — email-on-submit convenience is the real build.
  • The regulatory boundary is per-field, not per-vertical. Named clinic intake crosses into PHI / GDPR-Art-9 territory at the first identifier (BAA/DPA required — do not claim it). Anonymous screening, feedback, and education handouts are shippable now. FERPA blocks a NAMED gradebook on a personal account, but fully anonymous submissions fall outside it — so the teacher quiz defaults to anonymous, which the endpoint already is.
  • Teacher demand maps 1:1 onto the portability doctrine. The strongest TpT signal — no-prep, digital AND print from the same purchase — is literally one block list, three surfaces. The quiz feature floor was verified against Google's own docs. Honesty note: verbatim Reddit teacher quotes were unobtainable (search tooling returns zero reddit.com URLs), and several web facts carry DEMOTED-NO-RERUN provenance — beliefs, not measurements.

The analyst notebook exists end-to-end today and has been used twice. The missing screw is not machinery — it is a door handle, a starter, and a timestamp.

Risks & open questions

  • Byte-stability vs truth chrome. Freshness stamps change golden-locked render bytes on all three surfaces. The same underlying question surfaces in the notation and evidence lanes (must every surface render from source, or may the server pre-resolve, as TaskResolver already does?). Flagged to the capstone (/papers/papers-pro-toolkit-capstone) as the one doctrine call no lane can settle alone.
  • Feature-parity slippage is proven, not hypothetical. Annotations shipped web-only despite the 60-type parity gate — the gate locks types, not features. Every Move-1 chart feature must land as a three-surface SET with per-surface goldens, or the pack forks the surfaces further.
  • Each new aggregate source re-opens privacy design. k-anon floor, measure whitelist, and visibility cross-checks were task-shaped by construction. form_responses is the easiest first source (paper-anchored, per-form scope) but still needs its own k-anon story: a 3-student quiz must not leak an individual through an aggregate.
  • Demand is inferred, not measured. Corpus usage of about zero is now explained as a supply artifact — but that cuts both ways: there is no proof of pent-up demand either. Move 0 is the cheapest falsifiable test: if starters + templates move usage, build the screws; if not, re-examine before waves 2-3.
  • Golden-locked forms.ex. Submit UI and question types v2 both require regenerating form.golden.json and the email twin — mechanical, but merge-order sensitive (the guard+fix co-merge trap applies).
  • Demoted web facts. Google Forms close/cap, Tally/Typeform tier deltas, TpT scale figures all carry DEMOTED-NO-RERUN provenance — verify before scoping stage 6 against them.
  • The working tree lies. The local checkout is behind origin/main; every form-lane fact here was read via git show origin/main. Builders must re-read from origin, never trust local absence.

Left explicitly to the user:

  • 1 · Clinic scope: ship anonymous screening/feedback only (safe now), or also map the BAA/DPA compliance path as priced future work? Recommendation: anonymous-first, with regulated-data templates explicitly flagged.
  • 2 · Quiz grading: ratify server-side grading (graded response doc; all surfaces honest) over client-side self-check? Recommendation: server-side.
  • 3 · Query-source order: ratify form_responses as the FIRST generalized aggregate source and defer document-source aggregates entirely? Recommendation: yes.
  • 4 · Computed cells: ratify sheets-are-the-only-formula-context as permanent doctrine, or keep it v1 pragmatism with a possible table total-row exception later?
  • 5 · Build-vs-light weighting: accept the three-wave order (light first, capability second, generalization third)?
  • 6 · Freshness-stamp placement (block chrome vs document footer) — deferred to the capstone's doctrine call, but the user can pre-empt it here.
